title: Counting Worlds Branching Time Semantics for post-hoc Bias Mitigation in generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the probability distribution of gender outcomes (e.g., male, female, trans) in a series of generative AI outputs (such as images generated from the prompt "Give me a picture of an engineer") using a branching-time logic framework (CTLF) with counting worlds semantics to verify if the output series respects a target fairness distribution.
